gloss: issuing (of a declaration, warning or notice)

definitions.gloss: issuing (of a declaration, warning or notice)
definitions.explanation: The official issuing of an order, declaration, warning or notice, by a government or other authority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発出|はっしゅつ}。
⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緊急事態宣言|きんきゅうじたいせんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発出|はっしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The government issued a state-of-emergency declaration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発出|はっしゅつ}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけられた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: A heavy-rain warning was issued and residents were urged to evacuate.

notes:
An official word. It became widely familiar during the COVID-19 pandemic through {緊急事態宣言|きんきゅうじたいせんげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発出|はっしゅつ}. The passive {発出|はっしゅつ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ is common in news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発出|はっしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to issue a declaration
- ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発出|はっしゅつ}: the issuing of a warning
- ⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発出|はっしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to issue a notice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧: issuing an official order or warning
- ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: announcement, the general word
- ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to issue, the everyday verb
